methodology.cut: estimated uses the ranking file cut; verified_exceptions gives any materialized correction when the search summary exists
methodology.shares: row shares divide by selected symbols; length >=5 defines long fusion. Width-4 histogram is available separately
methodology.raw_gains: same original dispatch-unit credits replayed for B/C on the four training families after priority resolution and overlap. Equal family weight, no transfer multiplier
methodology.one_family: at predicted native dispatch sites, credit is earned in exactly one training family. Row denominator is all selected symbols with a winning site. Gain denominator is all credited dispatch units over all families
methodology.contexts: at most 32 unique pairs of neighboring exact candidate IDs or sentinels per candidate; operand shapes count distinct exact candidate IDs for the first member, capped at 32
